work_units.responsibility: Map each systemd unit to a cohesive single-service Nix module

findings.claim: Each systemd unit can move to one named subservice module with same-name timers or paths colocated.
Worker services need individual modules while their shared factory may remain centralized.

gaps: The upstream lx-annotate web ExecStart remains owned by the pinned application NixOS module.

work_units.responsibility: Design readable option-group boundaries for the existing public configuration contract

findings.claim: The public option surface can be split by top-level group without changing services.luxnix.lxAnnotateLocal paths.
runtime-context.nix should remain the source of derived paths and identities during this structural refactor.

gaps: Nested runtime and hub option groups can be split later if top-level grouping is still too large.

work_units.responsibility: Identify tests plus documentation that constrain a behavior-preserving module split

findings.claim: The Nix evaluation contract is the primary behavior-preservation suite for service names, commands, ordering, environment, hardening, timers, and assertions.
Several source-text tests must read the new owning modules instead of assuming all definitions live in config.nix or options.nix.
README.md already documents stable unit names and operational roles and should become the service-module manifest.

gaps: No existing test enforces one systemd service declaration per subservice file.
